cards.name: Skyshroud Ranger
cards.text: {T}: You may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.

printings.name: Skyshroud Ranger
printings.text: {T}: You may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
printings.flavor: Not even the elves truly know the Skyshroud Forest. The rangers are merely the best equipped to handle its uncertainty.

rulings.text: Putting the card onto the battlefield is optional. When the ability resolves, you can choose not to.

foreignNames.name: Wolkenwaldläufer
foreignNames.text: {T}: Du kannst eine Länderkarte aus deiner Hand ins Spiel bringen. Spiele diese Fähigkeit nur zu einem Zeitpunkt, zu dem du auch eine Hexerei spielen könntest.
foreignNames.flavor: Noch nicht einmal die Elfen kennen den Wolkenwald genau. Ihre Waldläufer sind lediglich am besten dafür gerüstet, mit seinen vielen Geheimnissen umzugehen.

foreignNames.name: Explorador de Veloceleste
foreignNames.text: {T}: Puedes poner en juego una carta de tierra de tu mano. Juega esta habilidad sólo cuando puedas jugar un conjuro.
foreignNames.flavor: Ni siquiera los elfos conocen verdaderamente el bosque de Veloceleste. Los exploradores son simplemente los mejor equipados para manejar sus incertidumbres.

foreignNames.name: Ranger de Linciel
foreignNames.text: {T} : Vous pouvez mettre en jeu une carte de terrain de votre main. Ne jouez cette capacité que lorsque vous pourriez jouer un rituel.
foreignNames.flavor: Même les elfes ne connaissent pas vraiment la forêt de Linciel. Les rangers sont simplement les mieux équipés pour affronter ses mystères.

foreignNames.name: Ranger di Cielsudario
foreignNames.text: {T}: Puoi mettere in gioco una carta terra dalla tua mano. Gioca questa abilità solo quando potresti giocare una stregoneria.
foreignNames.flavor: Neppure gli elfi conoscono realmente la Foresta di Cielsudario. I ranger sono sì e no i meglio equipaggiati per affrontare la sua incertezza.

foreignNames.name: スカイシュラウドのレインジャー
foreignNames.text: {T}：あなたの手札にある土地カードを１枚場に出してもよい。 この能力は、あなたがソーサリーをプレイできるときにのみプレイできる。
foreignNames.type: クリーチャー — エルフ
foreignNames.flavor: エルフ達ですらスカイシュラウドの森を真に知っているとは言えない。 レインジャーは単に、その不確かさを武器として扱うのに最も長けているだけだ。

foreignNames.name: Patrulheiro de Skyshroud
foreignNames.text: {T}: Você pode colocar um card de terreno em jogo vindo de sua mão. Use esta habilidade somente quando puder jogar um feitiço.
foreignNames.flavor: Nem mesmo os elfos conhecem completamente a Floresta de Skyshroud. Os patrulheiros são os mais preparados para lidar com sua incerteza.

foreignNames.name: Скайшраудский Лесничий
foreignNames.text: {T}: Вы можете положить карту земли из вашей руки в игру. Разыгрывайте эту способность только при возможности разыгрывать волшебство.

rulings.text: A spell or ability that counters spells can still target spells that can’t be countered. When that spell or ability resolves, the uncounterable spell won’t be countered, but any additional effects of the countering spell or ability will still happen.

Allosaurus Shepherd’s last ability overwrites all previous effects that set the affected creatures’ power and/or toughness to specific values. Other effects that set these characteristics to specific values that start to apply after the ability resolves will overwrite that part of the effect.

Effects that modify an affected creature’s power or toughness without setting it will apply no matter when they started to take effect. The same is true for counters that change the creature’s power or toughness.
The affected creatures don’t lose any abilities when they become Dinosaurs.

rulings.text: Energy counters aren’t permanents. Paying {E} won’t satisfy a revolt ability.

Revolt abilities check only whether a permanent you controlled left the battlefield this turn or not. They don’t apply multiple times if more than one permanent you controlled left the battlefield. They don’t check whether the permanent that left the battlefield is still in the zone it moved to.

Revolt abilities don’t care why the permanent left the battlefield, who caused it to move, or where it moved to. They’re equally satisfied by an artifact you sacrificed to pay a cost, a creature you controlled that was destroyed by Murder, or an enchantment you returned to your hand with Leave in the Dust.
Tokens that leave the battlefield will satisfy a revolt ability.

printings.originalText: {T}: Add {G}.

printings.name: Elvish Mystic
printings.text: {T}: Add {G}.
printings.flavor:
"The Three Rings of the Elves were not made as weapons of war or conquest—that is not their power. Those who made them did not desire strength or domination or hoarded wealth, but understanding, making, and healing, to preserve all things unstained."
—Elrond

foreignNames.name: Elfen-Mystiker
foreignNames.text: {T}: Erzeuge {G}.
foreignNames.flavor:
„Die drei Ringe der Elben wurden nicht als Waffen für Krieg und Eroberung geschmiedet — ihre Macht liegt anderswo. Jene, die sie fertigten, begehrten weder Stärke noch Herrschaft oder gehortete Reichtümer, sondern Wissen, Schöpfung und Heilung, um alles Makellose zu behüten."
—Elrond

foreignNames.name: Místico élfico
foreignNames.text: {T}: Agrega {G}.
foreignNames.flavor:
"Los Tres Anillos de los elfos no se crearon como armas de guerra o conquista. No es ese el poder que tienen. Quienes los forjaron no anhelaban ni fuerza ni dominio ni riqueza, sino comprender, crear y curar con tal de preservar todo de forma impoluta".
—Elrond

foreignNames.name: Mystique elfe
foreignNames.text: {T} : Ajoutez {G}.
foreignNames.flavor:
« Les trois Anneaux des Elfes ne furent pas créés comme des armes de guerre ou de conquête ; là n'est pas leur pouvoir. Ceux qui les ont forgés ne désiraient ni force, ni domination, ni richesse, mais la compréhension, la création et la guérison, pour préserver toutes choses immaculées. »
—Elrond

foreignNames.name: Elfo Mistico
foreignNames.text: {T}: Aggiungi {G}.
foreignNames.flavor:
"I Tre Anelli degli Elfi non furono fabbricati per servire come armi di guerra e di conquista: non è questo il loro potere. Coloro che li forgiarono non desideravano forza o dominazione, né accumulavano tesori; cercavano di capire, fabbricare e curare, per mantenere ogni cosa immacolata."
—Elrond

foreignNames.name: エルフの神秘家
foreignNames.text: {T}：{G}を加える。
foreignNames.type: クリーチャー — エルフ・ドルイド
foreignNames.flavor:
「エルフの三つの指輪は戦いや征服のための武器として作られたものではない――この指輪の力はそのようなものではない。三つの指輪を作った者たちは、力や支配や蓄えた富などは願わず、すべてを浄く保つため、理解し、作り、癒す力を望んだ。」
――エルロンド

foreignNames.name: Místico Élfico
foreignNames.text: {T}: Adicione {G}.
foreignNames.flavor:
"Os Três Anéis dos Elfos não foram feitos como armas de guerra nem de conquista — esse não é o poder deles. Os que os fizeram não desejavam força nem dominância nem acumular riquezas, mas entendimento, criação e cura, a preservação imaculada de todas as coisas."
— Elrond

cards.text: Whenever Copperhorn Scout attacks, untap each other creature you control.

printings.name: Copperhorn Scout
printings.text: Whenever Copperhorn Scout attacks, untap each other creature you control.
printings.flavor: Fangren spur may sound louder, but Viridian resurgents claim that the horn of the vorrac creates a truer, more inspiring note.

rulings.text: As Copperhorn Scout’s ability resolves, you’ll untap each other creature you control regardless of whether that creature was attacking.
Untapping an attacking creature doesn’t cause it to stop attacking.

foreignNames.name: 銅角笛の斥候
foreignNames.text: 銅角笛の斥候が攻撃するたび、あなたがコントロールする他の各クリーチャーをそれぞれアンタップする。
foreignNames.type: クリーチャー — エルフ・スカウト
foreignNames.flavor: ヴィリジアンの復活者たちの主張によれば、ファングレンの蹴爪の音の方が大きいかもしれないが、ヴォラックの角の方がより正確で、より感動的な音を奏でるそうだ。

foreignNames.name: 铜号斥候
foreignNames.text: 每当铜号斥候攻击时，重置由你操控的其他生物。
foreignNames.flavor: 方壬刺制品的声音也许比较响亮，但中兴暗碧族宣称博锐兽角制品所发出的音符更加真实而激励人心。

foreignNames.name: Kupferhornspäher
foreignNames.text: Immer wenn der Kupferhornspäher angreift, enttappe alle anderen Kreaturen, die du kontrollierst.
foreignNames.flavor: Es kann sein, dass Fangrensporen lauter klingen, aber viridische Resurgenten behaupten, dass das Horn eines Vorrac einen klareren, aufweckenderen Ton ertönen lässt.

foreignNames.name: Explorador cuernocúpreo
foreignNames.text: Siempre que el Explorador cuernocúpreo ataque, endereza cada otra criatura que controles.
foreignNames.flavor: Las espuelas de fangren pueden sonar más fuerte, pero los insurrectos viridianos afirman que el cuerno de un vórrac crea una nota más pura e inspiradora.

foreignNames.name: Éclaireur cuivrecorne
foreignNames.text: À chaque fois que l'Éclaireur cuivrecorne attaque, dégagez chaque autre créature que vous contrôlez.
foreignNames.flavor: L'éperon de Fangren résonne peut-être plus fort, mais les renaissants viridians prétendent que la corne du vorrac crée une note plus pure, plus inspiratrice.

foreignNames.name: Esploratrice dal Corno Ramato
foreignNames.text: Ogniqualvolta l'Esploratrice dal Corno Ramato attacca, STAPpa ogni altra creatura che controlli.
foreignNames.flavor: Lo sperone dei fangren può suonare più forte, ma i rinascenti Viridiani affermano che il corno dei vorrac crea una nota più intonata e ispiratrice.

foreignNames.name: 銅角笛の斥候

foreignNames.name: Batedor Chifre-de-Cobre
foreignNames.text: Toda vez que Batedor Chifre-de-Cobre atacar, desvire cada uma das outras criaturas que você controla.
foreignNames.flavor: Uma espora de fangren pode soar mais alto, mas os viridianos ressurgentes afirmam que o chifre do vorrac cria uma nota mais verdadeira e inspiradora.

foreignNames.name: Разведчик Медного Рога
foreignNames.text: Каждый раз когда Разведчик Медного Рога атакует, разверните каждое другое существо под вашим контролем.
foreignNames.flavor: Может, рог фангрена звучит громче, но восставшие виридийцы утверждают, что рог воррака издает более чистую и вдохновляющую ноту.

foreignNames.flavor: 方壬刺製品的聲音也許比較響亮，但中興暗碧族宣稱博銳獸角製品所發出的音符更加真實而激勵人心。

cards.name: Scattershot Archer
cards.text: {T}: Scattershot Archer deals 1 damage to each creature with flying.

printings.name: Scattershot Archer
printings.text: {T}: Scattershot Archer deals 1 damage to each creature with flying.
printings.flavor: To train her elves for war, Mayael would drop a sackful of acorns from the tree canopy. Each archer tried to split as many as possible before the acorns hit the forest floor below.

foreignNames.name: Streuschuss-Bogenschütze
foreignNames.text: {T}: Der Streuschuss-Bogenschütze fügt allen fliegenden Kreaturen 1 Schadenspunkt zu.
foreignNames.flavor: Um ihre Elfen auf den Krieg vorzubereiten, kippte Mayael oft einen Sack Eicheln aus der Baumspitze. Jeder Schütze versuchte, davon so viele wie möglich zu zerteilen, bevor die Eicheln den Boden berührten.

foreignNames.name: Arquero desperdigador
foreignNames.text: {T}: El Arquero desperdigador hace 1 punto de daño a cada criatura con la habilidad de volar.
foreignNames.flavor: Para entrenar a sus elfos para la guerra, Mayael dejaba caer un saco de bellotas desde un árbol. Cada arquero intentaba partir tantas como fuera posible antes de que tocaran el suelo.

foreignNames.name: Archer tireur à la volée
foreignNames.text: {T} : L'Archer tireur à la volée inflige 1 blessure à chaque créature avec le vol.
foreignNames.flavor: Pour entraîner ses elfes à la guerre, Mayael lançait un sac de glands depuis la canopée. Chaque archer essayait d'en fendre le plus possible avant qu'ils ne touchent le sol de la forêt.

foreignNames.name: Arciere Laceratore
foreignNames.text: {T}: L'Arciere Laceratore infligge 1 danno a ogni creatura con volare.
foreignNames.flavor: Per preparare i suoi elfi alla guerra, Mayael avrebbe lanciato una manciata di ghiande dall'alto di un albero. Ciascun arciere avrebbe tentato di spezzarne il più possibile prima che le ghiande fossero riuscite a toccare terra.

foreignNames.name: 散弾の射手
foreignNames.text: {T}：散弾の射手は飛行を持つ各クリーチャーにそれぞれ１点のダメージを与える。
foreignNames.type: クリーチャー — エルフ・射手
foreignNames.flavor: エルフを戦争に向けて鍛えるため、メイエルは樹の梢から袋いっぱいのどんぐりを撒き落とす。 それが地面に落ちるまでの間、射手はできるだけ多くのどんぐりを断ち割ろうとする。

foreignNames.name: Arqueiro do Tiro a Esmo
foreignNames.text: {T}: Arqueiro do Tiro a Esmo causa 1 ponto de dano a cada criatura com voar.
foreignNames.flavor: Para treinar seus elfos para a guerra, Mayael é capaz de derrubar um monte de bolotas da copa de uma árvore. Cada arqueiro deve tentar rachar o máximo de bolotas possível antes que elas toquem o chão da floresta.

foreignNames.name: Сноровистый Лучник
foreignNames.text: {T}: Сноровистый Лучник наносит 1 повреждение каждому существу с Полетом.
foreignNames.flavor: Чтобы подготовить своих эльфов к войне, Майел опрокидывала с дерева мешок желудей. Каждый лучник старался поразить как можно больше целей до тех пор, пока желуди не коснутся земли.

foreignNames.name: 散射弓箭手
foreignNames.text: {T}：散射弓箭手对每个具飞行异能的生物各造成1点伤害。
foreignNames.flavor: 为训练手下地精备战，梅燕会从树冠洒下一整袋橡实。 每位弓箭手都设法在橡实落到树林地面前多劈开几颗。

cards.text: {T}: Add {C}.

printings.name: Boreal Druid
printings.text: {T}: Add {C}.
printings.flavor: Some creatures are bound to the cold by Rimewind magic. Others seek it out, adapted by two thousand years of the Ice. The Boreal, where Heidar's frigid sway is strongest, is home to both.

foreignNames.name: Borealis-Druide
foreignNames.text: {T}: Erhöhe deinen Manavorrat um {1}.
foreignNames.flavor: Manche Kreaturen sind durch die Raureif-Magie an die Kälte gebunden. Andere haben sich in zweitausend Jahren Eiszeit an sie gewöhnt und fühlen sich darin wohl. In Borealis, wo Heidars kalte Macht am stärksten ist, trifft man auf beide Arten.

foreignNames.name: Druida boreal
foreignNames.text: {T}: Agrega {1} a tu reserva de maná.
foreignNames.flavor: Algunas criaturas están ligadas al frío por la magia brisa escarchada. Otros lo buscan, adaptados por dos mil años de Hielo. Boreal, donde la influencia gélida de Heidar es más fuerte, es hogar para unos y otros.

foreignNames.name: Druide de Boréal
foreignNames.text: {T} : Ajoutez {1} à votre réserve.
foreignNames.flavor: Certaines créatures sont liées au froid par la magie de Soufflegivre. D'autres en ont besoin pour survivre, après s'être adaptées aux glaces pendant deux mille ans. Boréal, où le pouvoir glacé d'Heidar est le plus puissant, les abrite toutes.

foreignNames.name: Druido di Borealia
foreignNames.text: {T}: Aggiungi {1} alla tua riserva di mana.
foreignNames.flavor: Alcune creature sono legate al freddo dalla magia di Ventogelo. Altre lo cercano, abituate a duemila anni di Ghiaccio. A Borealia, dove l'onda gelida di Heidar è più forte, si trovano entrambi i tipi.

foreignNames.name: ボリアルのドルイド
foreignNames.text: {T}：あなたのマナ・プールに{1}を加える。
foreignNames.type: 氷雪クリーチャー — エルフ・ドルイド
foreignNames.flavor: 霧氷風の魔術に凍える定めのものもいる。 それを求め、二千年の氷の時に適応したものもいる。 ハイダーが治める、中でも最も寒さの厳しいボリアルは、そのどちらにとっても拠り所だ。

foreignNames.name: Druida Boreal
foreignNames.text: {T}: Adiciona {1} à sua reserva de mana.
foreignNames.flavor: Algumas criaturas estão condenadas ao frio pela mágica dos Vento-Gélido. Outras anseiam por ele, adaptadas por dois mil anos de Gelo. Boreal, onde a frígida influência de Heidar é mais forte, é o lar de ambas.

foreignNames.name: 波利尔德鲁伊
foreignNames.text: {T}：加{1}到你的法术力池中。
foreignNames.flavor: 霜风会法术造成的严寒使某些生物困顿不已。 其余者则由于经历两千年的冰雪时代，早已逐渐适应。 波利尔位于亥达寒冰势力最强盛之处，这两种生物也最多。

foreignNames.name: Elfischer Lobredner
foreignNames.text: Opfere den Elfischen Lobredner: Du erhältst für jede Elfenkarte auf deinem Friedhof 1 Lebenspunkt dazu.
foreignNames.flavor: „Egal, wie meisterhaft unsere künstlerischen Fähigkeiten sind: Unseren Abbildern wird es nie ganz gelingen, die lebendige Schönheit eines Elfen wiedergeben zu können. Vielleicht ist das der Grund, warum wir trauern."

foreignNames.name: Panegirista élfica
foreignNames.text: Sacrificar la Panegirista élfica: Gana 1 vida por cada carta de Elfo en tu cementerio.
foreignNames.flavor: "Sin importar qué tan hábiles seamos artísticamente, nuestros retratos nunca podrán capturar la belleza verdadera de un elfo vivo. Tal vez es eso realmente por lo que lloramos a nuestros muertos."

foreignNames.name: Eulogiste elfe
foreignNames.text: Sacrifiez l'Eulogiste elfe : Vous gagnez 1 point de vie pour chaque carte d'elfe dans votre cimetière.
foreignNames.flavor: « En dépit de nos grands talents artistiques, nos effigies n'ont jamais réussi à capturer la beauté vibrante d'un elfe vivant. En fait, c'est peut-être là ce que nous pleurons. »

foreignNames.name: Elogiatrice Elfica
foreignNames.text: Sacrifica l'Elogiatrice Elfica: Guadagni 1 punto vita per ogni carta Elfo nel tuo cimitero.
foreignNames.flavor: "Non importa quanto eccelsa sia la nostra abilità artistica, le nostre effigi non potranno mai sperare di catturare la bellezza vibrante di un elfo vivo. Forse è proprio per questo che siamo in lutto."

foreignNames.name: エルフの賛美者
foreignNames.text: エルフの賛美者を生け贄に捧げる：あなたはあなたの墓地にあるエルフ・カード１枚につき１点のライフを得る。
foreignNames.type: クリーチャー — エルフ・シャーマン
foreignNames.flavor: 「我々の芸術的手腕がどれだけ巧みであろうと、生けるエルフの生命の美しさを像が捕らえることなど望むべくもない。 実に嘆き悲しむべきことなのだろうな。」

foreignNames.name: Elogiadora Élfica
foreignNames.text: Sacrifique Elogiadora Élfica: Você ganha 1 ponto de vida para cada card de Elfo no seu cemitério
foreignNames.flavor: "Não importa nossa habilidade artística, nossas efígies nunca poderão sequer capturar a beleza vibrante de um elfo vivo. Talvez seja por isso que estamos de luto."

foreignNames.name: Эльфийский Панегирист
foreignNames.text: Пожертвуйте Эльфийского Панегириста: Вы получаете 1 жизнь за каждую карту Эльфа на вашем кладбище.
foreignNames.flavor: "Сколь искусными ни были бы наши творения, они никогда не смогут передать яркую красоту живого эльфа. Возможно, именно поэтому мы и скорбим".

foreignNames.name: 地精赞颂人
foreignNames.text: 牺牲地精赞颂人：你坟墓场中每有一张地精牌，你便获得1点生命。
foreignNames.flavor: 「不论我们的艺术技巧如何进展，所绘肖像绝对不可能捕捉活生生地精的跃动风采。 或许这就是我们真正哀痛的原因。」

cards.name: Pelt Collector
cards.text:
Whenever another creature you control enters the battlefield or dies, if that creature's power is greater than Pelt Collector's, put a +1/+1 counter on Pelt Collector.
As long as Pelt Collector has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, it has trample.

printings.name: Pelt Collector
printings.text:
Whenever another creature you control enters the battlefield or dies, if that creature's power is greater than Pelt Collector's, put a +1/+1 counter on Pelt Collector.
As long as Pelt Collector has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, it has trample.

rulings.text: As Pelt Collector’s first ability resolves, if the entering creature’s power is no longer greater than Pelt Collector’s power, or if Pelt Collector’s power has been raised to greater than or equal to the power of the creature that died, Pelt Collector doesn’t get a +1/+1 counter. Notably, this means that if Pelt Collector is still a 1/1 creature and two 2/2 creatures die, it only gets one +1/+1 counter as the first triggered ability resolves, and it will be too big to get a counter as the second triggered ability resolves.

If Pelt Collector is dealt lethal damage at the same time as a larger creature you control, they’re destroyed at the same time. Pelt Collector won’t get an additional +1/+1 from its ability in time to save it.

If Pelt Collector’s power becomes less than 0, a creature with 0 power (or with power less than 0 but still greater than Pelt Collector’s power) entering the battlefield or dying will cause its first ability to trigger.

If a creature with power less than or equal to Pelt Collector’s power enters the battlefield or dies, Pelt Collector’s first ability doesn’t trigger at all. You can’t try to raise that creature’s power or lower Pelt Collector’s to get a counter.

If the entering creature leaves the battlefield while Pelt Collector’s triggered ability is on the stack, use its power as it last existed on the battlefield to determine whether Pelt Collector gets a +1/+1 counter.
To determine if Pelt Collector’s first ability triggers when a creature dies, use its power as it last existed on the battlefield.

To determine if Pelt Collector’s first ability triggers when a creature enters the battlefield, use the creature’s power after applying any static abilities (such as that of Trostani Discordant) that modify its power.

rulings.text: The abilities a leveler grants to itself don’t overwrite any other abilities it may have. In particular, they don’t overwrite the creature’s level up ability; it always has that.

Effects that set a leveler’s power or toughness to a specific value, including the effects from a level symbol’s ability, apply in timestamp order. The timestamp of each level symbol’s ability is the same as the timestamp of the leveler itself, regardless of when the most recent level counter was put on it.

Effects that modify a leveler’s power or toughness, such as the effects of Giant Growth or Glorious Anthem, will apply to it no matter when they started to take effect. The same is true for counters that change the creature’s power or toughness (such as +1/+1 counters) and effects that switch its power and toughness.

If another creature becomes a copy of a leveler, all of the leveler’s printed abilities — including those represented by level symbols — are copied. The current characteristics of the leveler, and the number of level counters on it, are not. The abilities, power, and toughness of the copy will be determined based on how many level counters are on the copy.

A creature’s level is based on how many level counters it has on it, not how many times its level up ability has been activated or has resolved. If a leveler gets level counters due to some other effect (such as Clockspinning) or loses level counters for some reason (such as Vampire Hexmage), its level is changed accordingly.
If Joraga Treespeaker is level 5 or greater, it grants the mana ability to each Elf you control, including itself.

foreignNames.flavor: オラ・オンダール、つまりカルニの庭は、アクームの厳しい土地で絡まり合う繁茂である。その地の植物は驚愕の多様性を見せる。鮮やかな生命の輝かしい混合と、速やかな死が、そこにある。

foreignNames.name: 타주루 역병칼날
foreignNames.text: 치명타
foreignNames.flavor: 칼니 정원인 오라 온다르는 아쿰의 거친 대지 속에서 자라난 것들이 뒤엉켜 있는 곳이다. 그곳의 식물들의 성장 방식은 놀라울 정도로 다양하다. 활기찬 생명이 영롱하게 펼쳐진 것과 동시에 . . . 빠른 죽음도 함께 있다.

foreignNames.name: Venenolâmina Tajuru
foreignNames.text: Toque mortífero
foreignNames.flavor: Ora Ondar, o Jardim de Khalni, é um emaranhado exuberante nas terras agrestes de Akoum. A flora é maravilhosamente diversa, um brilhante espectro de vida vibrante... e mortes rápidas.

foreignNames.name: Клинок Погибели из Таджуру
foreignNames.text: Смертельное касание
foreignNames.flavor: Ора-Ондар, Сад Кални, — это заросли пышной растительности в суровых землях Акума. Флора здесь удивительно разнообразная — полный спектр яркой жизни... и быстрой смерти.

foreignNames.name: 特裘如枯刃客
foreignNames.text: 死触
foreignNames.flavor: 欧拉昂达又称坎尼花园，是阿库姆荒地中一处葱郁丛林。此处植物种类繁多、包罗万象：既有茁壮成长的盎然生机. . .也有能迅速致命的剧烈毒物。

foreignNames.name: 特裘如枯刃客
foreignNames.text: 死觸
foreignNames.flavor: 歐拉昂達又稱坎尼花園，是阿庫姆荒地中一處蔥鬱叢林。此處植物種類繁多、包羅萬象：既有茁壯成長的盎然生機. . .也有能迅速致命的劇烈毒物。

decision.english_query: Find green Elf creatures with mana value exactly 1.
